content.text: [structured-output-enforce] You MUST call the StructuredOutput tool to complete this request. Call this tool now.

candidates.explanation: The verification link for a changed email is built with the path '/confirm-email'. That is the same frontend page the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp) uses. It should point to a dedicated '/confirm-new-email' page. The page the link opens is the sign-up confirmation page, which presumably calls POST /auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint only accepts users whose status is inactive and ignores the newEmail claim in the token. An active user changing their email therefore gets a 404 or an error, and the email is never changed. The correct page would call the confirm-new-email endpoint, which is handled by AuthService.confirmNewEmail.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'. The frontend page at that path can then call the confirm-new-email endpoint.
